title: Need insight on 3FE to 1HDT swap
transmission: H150/H151 5-speed manual (discussed) or retained factory automatic
ai_summary: Owner of a 1991 gas (3FE-powered) 80-series Land Cruiser sought guidance on swapping in a 1HD-T (or 1HD-FT/12H-T alternatives), with experienced members recommending H150/H151 5-speed manuals as most desirable, welding in HDJ80 engine mounts, and estimating roughly $5,000 for engine plus supporting parts. This is a planning/advice thread rather than a documented completed build.

complications.detail: Requires welding HDJ80 engine mounts into the FJ80 frame
Disagreement among members on whether firewall cutting is needed for clearance
